“ऊर्ध्वमूलमधःशाखमश्वत्थं प्राहुरव्ययम् ।”
(Oordhvamoolamadhah saakhamasvattham praahurvyayam.)
“They (wise people) speak of the indestructible Pippal Tree (ficus Religiosa) having its root above and branches below.” ―Geeta XV-1.

“ऊर्ध्वमूलोऽवाक्शाख एषोऽश्वत्थः सनातनः ।”
(Oordhvamoolo-avaaksaakha esho-asvatthah sanaatanah.)
“This is the ancient Asvattha Tree, whose roots are above and branches (spread) below.” ―Katha Ch. II-VI-1.
